type.v210_bridge.cfg.direction.label: Bridge direction
type.v210_bridge.cfg.direction.opt.expor: Export — internal planar → v210 mirror (for a third party)
type.v210_bridge.cfg.direction.opt.impor: Import — third-party v210 flow → internal planar
type.v210_bridge.cfg.import_flow.help: Raw flowId UUID of a third-party video/v210 flow (GET /flows on the container lists the candidates discovered in the domain), or the name of an in-house flow.
type.v210_bridge.cfg.import_flow.label: Source v210 flow (flowId UUID or name)
type.v210_bridge.cfg.log_level.help: Container log verbosity. Default “Events”: notable facts (start/stop, format change, reconnection, fallback to a degraded path, an input appearing or disappearing) are ALWAYS written — after a failure the log must let you reconstruct the story, and raising the level afterwards recovers nothing. Periodic metrics (fps, counters) are NOT logged: they are already published on :8080. “Verbose” = a flamethrower, one line per frame, to be enabled only for the duration of a diagnosis (the Docker log is not rotated).
type.v210_bridge.cfg.log_level.label: Log level
type.v210_bridge.cfg.out_name.help: Name of the MXL flow published for third parties (empty = <hostname>_v210). Its flowId (UUID) is exposed on /state — that is what a third-party container targets.
type.v210_bridge.cfg.out_name.label: v210 mirror flow name
type.v210_bridge.label: v210 bridge
